F001.notes: Content type definitions must move to shared core before lite implementation starts.

F002.notes: Use saved contents HTML fixtures for seiga and video.

F003.notes: Expected rows must include title, URL, IDs, contribution, thumbnail source, type, and no fixed 500-row cap.

F004.notes: SVG path rank detection is fragile and must be covered.

F005.notes: Both renderers should consume the same normalized result items.

F006.notes: UI may differ, but visible item semantics must match, including rank and contribution sorting.

F007.notes: Node upload and lite File API should enforce the same input validation expectations.

F008.notes: Lite persisted history is optional and must be opt-in if added.

F009.notes: CSV column order and BOM behavior should stay stable.

F010.notes: Clipboard TSV columns should match the CSV-facing result fields.

F011.notes: Node writes HTML; lite renders DOM. Result operations must stay equivalent.

F012.notes: Lite local thumbnail reuse depends on user-selected files or directories.

F013.notes: Lite remote thumbnail enrichment is best-effort because of CORS.

F014.notes: Lite must work from GitHub Pages without server endpoints.

F015.notes: Lite may persist parsed result data in localStorage, but must not store uploaded HTML source.
